21.title: Implement validated atomic inventory file library
21.body:
Implements Issue #6: other Python programs can validate, load and atomically save accepted format-v1 inventory documents. Invalid content and duplicate IDs are rejected before modifying a destination. The README documents the usable API and atomic-replacement boundary.

Spec pin: Issue #6, spec_sha256=05254ec36c91071580cc72e49527a36f4403b403712cf7aaba26873a996bb9f2, acceptance https://github.com/fixture/receipt-desk/issues/6#issuecomment-1.

Fixed integrated candidate: 4624e8616be2b2731808a4a9230754e2a0b48f7b, local shared/codex/check-route-repair; base b66b48cc9e28e9d17639406a17bc609ff80b2a9a. Includes original library 5331b0bbab3ece9e94ddac3fe24def2ddf7a2180 and project check entry. The setup candidate 22b6afb1868cf59018885e4a0fe72f20ecdd4437 failed before library tests because development-loop linked absent verification-entry.md. This candidate restores its route to the existing verification.md. Original failure remains in Issue #6 comment #9.

Validation: Python 3.14.2, `python3 scripts/check.py --base 22b6afb1868cf59018885e4a0fe72f20ecdd4437` passed on this clean fixed candidate: local Corp check plus all 11 behavior/example tests executed. `git diff --check` passed. The exact shared branch commit was verified with git ls-remote.

Limits: implementation/self-check only. Independent stage judgment, integration and formal delivery remain outstanding. No writer locking or power-loss durability guarantee. No real GitHub publication, network CI, main update or Owner comprehension evidence. Issues #8/#9 retain their own scope. Successor should recover Issue #6 checkpoint and use the generated stage-review route; the route repair implementer has not independently reviewed this candidate.
